Pending.label: Awaiting triage
Pending.meaning: Report submitted; acceptance and assignment are pending.
Pending.next: Quality reviewer: review the report and assign an investigator.

Needs clarification.label: Needs clarification
Needs clarification.meaning: More information is needed before acceptance.
Needs clarification.next: Reporter: answer the reviewer's questions in Comments & evidence.

Accepted.label: Accepted
Accepted.meaning: The report has been accepted and an investigator assigned.
Accepted.next: Investigator: start the investigation before the deadline.

Investigating.label: Investigating
Investigating.meaning: Findings, root cause and the action plan are being prepared.
Investigating.next: Investigator: record findings, assess risk and prepare actions for approval.

Action in progress.label: Actions in progress
Action in progress.meaning: The action plan is approved; completion evidence is required.
Action in progress.next: Action owners: complete tasks and record evidence. Investigator: request closure when all tasks are complete.

Closure review.label: Awaiting closure review
Closure review.meaning: Actions are complete; independent effectiveness review is pending.
Closure review.next: Independent reviewer: verify effectiveness and residual risk, then close or return for further work.

Closed.label: Closed
Closed.meaning: An independent reviewer has approved closure.
Closed.next: No open workflow step. A reviewer may reopen the incident if new evidence appears.

Rejected.label: Rejected
Rejected.meaning: The report was not accepted; the reason is recorded in history.
Rejected.next: Read the decision in history. A reviewer may reopen the report with a reason.

Duplicate.label: Duplicate
Duplicate.meaning: The event was identified as an existing report.
Duplicate.next: Read the duplicate reference in history and follow the original report.

Reopened.label: Reopened
Reopened.meaning: Further investigation or action is required after a previous decision.
Reopened.next: Reviewer or investigator: confirm assignment and resume the investigation.

Resolved.label: Resolved — review required
Resolved.meaning: A legacy resolved status; this does not mean independently approved closure.
Resolved.next: Investigator: confirm findings, root cause and completed actions before requesting closure review.
